name: STA314H1 — Correction Attribution (Kernel Methods and Representer Theorem)

steps.template_en: 'SVM finds a separating hyperplane.' TRUE for linearly separable. But SVM WITH KERNELS finds nonlinear boundaries in ORIGINAL space by computing linear boundary in FEATURE space. The kernel trick makes this efficient.
steps.template_zh: 'SVM找分离超平面。'线性可分时为真。但核SVM通过在高维特征空间找线性边界来在原空间找非线性边界。核技巧使其高效。

steps.template_en: Kernel: k(x,x') = φ(x)·φ(x'), where φ maps to feature space. RBF kernel: k(x,x')=exp(-‖x-x'‖²/σ²). Implicitly maps to INFINITE-dimensional feature space. But we never compute φ explicitly — just k(x,x').
steps.template_zh: 核：k(x,x')=φ(x)·φ(x'), φ映射到特征空间。RBF核：exp(-‖x-x'‖²/σ²)。隐式映射到无穷维特征空间。但从不显式计算φ——只计算k(x,x')。

steps.template_en: Representer Theorem: the optimal w in the feature space has the form w = Σαᵢφ(xᵢ). Thus f(x)=w·φ(x)=Σαᵢk(xᵢ,x). Learning reduces to finding αᵢ. This is why kernel methods work with ANY kernel.
steps.template_zh: Representer定理：特征空间中最优w的形式为w=Σαᵢφ(xᵢ)。学习简化为求αᵢ。这就是核方法适用于任何核的原因。

steps.template_en: The kernel trick enables: (1) Nonlinear classification with linear methods. (2) Working in infinite-dim spaces with finite computation. (3) Using domain-specific similarity measures as kernels. (4) Combining kernels (multiple kernel learning).
steps.template_zh: 核技巧使能：(1)用线性方法做非线性分类。(2)有限计算处理无穷维空间。(3)用领域特定相似度量作为核。(4)组合核(多核学习)。

steps.template_en: On a nonlinear dataset: (1) Fit SVM with linear kernel. (2) Fit SVM with RBF kernel. (3) Tune C and γ via CV. (4) Plot decision boundaries. (5) Compare: when does RBF outperform linear?
steps.template_zh: 在非线性数据集上：(1)线性核SVM。(2)RBF核SVM。(3)通过CV调整C和γ。(4)画决策边界。(5)比较：RBF何时优于线性？

steps.template_en: Kernel methods are 'lazy learners' — they keep training data and use it at prediction time. Computational cost O(n²) or O(n³). For large n, neural nets scale better. But for small-to-medium n, SVMs are often state-of-the-art.
steps.template_zh: 核方法是'懒惰学习'——保留训练数据，预测时使用。计算成本O(n²)或O(n³)。大n时神经网络扩展性更好。但中小n时SVM常是最优的。
